fate.name: Bashful
fate.text: Evil Queen must pay 1 Power to perform the Brew Poison action.

fate.name: Doc
fate.text: Evil Queen must defeat Doc before defeating other Heroes.

fate.name: Dopey
fate.text: All other Heroes in Evil Queen's Realm get +1 Strength.

fate.name: Grumpy
fate.text: Grumpy gets +1 Strength if there are no other Heroes at his location.

fate.name: Happy
fate.text: When Happy is played, Evil Queen loses Poison equal to the number of Heroes in her Realm.

fate.name: Sleepy
fate.text: If Sleepy is revealed during a Fate action, you may play both cards revealed during that action.

fate.name: Sneezy
fate.text: When Sneezy is played, you may discard one Item from his location.

fate.name: Snow White
fate.text:
Snow White can only be played to the Dwarf's Cottage, even if its locked.
Snow White gets +1 Strength for each other Hero in Evil Queen's Realm.

fate.name: Wishing Well
fate.text: When Wishing Well is played, attach it to a Hero. Each time Evil Queen moves to this location, she immediately loses 1 Poison.

villain.name: Get Ready to Rumble!
villain.text: Either pay 2 Power to move an untrapped Titan to an adjacent location, or pay 5 Power to move an untrapped Titan two locations away.

villain.name: Mortality Potion
villain.text: When Mortality Potion is played, attach it to a Hero. Titans used to defeat that Hero are not discarded.

villain.name: Planets Align
villain.text: Untrap one or more Titans in your Realm. The Cost to play Planets Align is equal to the number of Titans you untrap.

villain.name: Achilles' Heel
villain.text: Choose a Hero. That Hero gets -2 Strength until the end of your turn.

villain.name: Eye of the Fates
villain.text: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an Ally or Titan. Put that Ally or Titan into your hand. Discard the rest.

villain.name: I Rule!
villain.text: Gain 1 Power for each Ally and Titan in your discard pile.

villain.name: Rage
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 3 or more, you may play Rage. Move a Hero in your Realm to any location.

villain.name: Ruthless
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has 6 or more Power, you may play Ruthless. Play an Ally or Titan from your hand for free.

villain.name: Arges
villain.text:
Arges can only be played to The Underworld.
When Arges is moved, gain 1 Power.

villain.name: Cerberus
villain.text: When performing a Vanquish action, Cerberus may be used to defeat a Hero at his location or at an adjacent location.

villain.name: Chariot
villain.text: Once per turn, if Hades is as this location, you may move Hades and Chariot to any location and perform one available action at the new location. You cannot use Chariot to perform Fate actions.

villain.name: Hydra
villain.text: When Hydra is used to defeat a Hero, you may put Hydra into your hand instead of discarding him.

villain.name: Hydros
villain.text:
Hydros can only be played to The Underworld.
Heroes at Hydros' location get -1 Strength and cannot be moved by Fate cards.

villain.name: Lythos
villain.text:
Lythos can only be played to The Underworld.
When Lythos is moved, you may perform a Vanquish action at his new location. Lythos must be used in that action.

villain.name: Nessus
villain.text: If Nessus is used to defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less, gain 2 Power.

villain.name: Pain
villain.text: When Pain is moved, you may move a Hero from Pain's previous location to his new location.

villain.name: Panic
villain.text: If Hades is at Panic's location, the Cost to play Items, Allies, and Titans is reduced by 1 Power.

villain.name: Pyros
villain.text:
Pyros can only be played to The Underworld.
When Pyros is moved, you may untrap one Titan at his new location.

villain.name: Stratos
villain.text:
Stratos can only be played to The Underworld.
When Stratos is moved, you may move a Hero from his new location to an adjacent location.

fate.name: Go the Distance
fate.text: Either move an untrapped Titan up to two locations away, ignoring all Hero and Titan Abilities, or move a Hero to any location.

fate.name: Lightning Bolt
fate.text: Choose a location in Hades' Realm. All Titans in that location are trapped.

fate.name: Medallion
fate.text: When Medallion is played, attach it to a Hero. That Hero gets +2 Strength.

fate.name: The Gospel Truth
fate.text: Discard an Item or Ally from Hades' Realm.

fate.name: Hera
fate.text: When Hera is played or moved, you may choose a Titan at her new location. That Titan is trapped.

fate.name: Hercules
fate.text: Titans cannot be moved from Hercules' location.

fate.name: Hermes
fate.text: When Hermes is played, if Zeus is in Hades' Realm, you may move Zeus to any location. Otherwise, find Zeus and put him on the top of Hades' Fate deck.

fate.name: Megara
fate.text: When Megara is played, you may move a Hero from her location to any location.

fate.name: Pegasus
fate.text: When Pegasus is played, you may move an untrapped Titan from his location to an adjacent location.

fate.name: Phil
fate.text: Phil and Hercules get +1 Strength if Hercules is in Hades' Realm.

fate.name: Zeus
fate.text: If a Titan moves to Zeus' location, that Titan is immediately trapped before the Titan's Ability is triggered.

villain.name: Gears
villain.text: When you play an Item, you may discard Gears from your Realm to reduce the Cost of that Item by 3 Power.

villain.name: Capture
villain.text: Move a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less to The Secret Lair.

villain.name: Ruffians
villain.text: If Ruffians are played to a location other than Ratigan's, you may perform one available action at their location. You cannot use Ruffians to perform Fate actions.

villain.name: Devious
villain.text: During their turn, if another player targets you with a Fate action, you may play Devious. That player reveals only one card from your Fate deck instead of two.

villain.name: Extravagant
villain.text: During their turn, if another player gains 3 or more Power, you may play Extravagant. Choose an Item from your discard pile and put it into your hand.

villain.name: Greatest Criminal Mind
villain.text: Either draw two cards or gain 2 Power.

villain.name: Marvelous Trap
villain.text: Activate: Pay 1 Power. Before Ratigan moves on your next turn, defeat all Heroes at this location. Discard Marvelous Trap.

villain.name: Uniform
villain.text: When Uniform is played, attach it to an Ally. That Ally gets +2 Strength and you may immediately perform a Vanquish action using that Ally.

villain.name: Airship
villain.text: Activate: Pay 1 Power. Move Airship and one Ally or unattached Item at its location to any location.

villain.name: Bartholomew
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Bell
villain.text: Activate: Take Felicia from your deck or discard pile and put her into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

villain.name: Felicia
villain.text: When Felicia is played, discard an Ally in your Realm or pay 2 Power.

villain.name: Fidget
villain.text: When Fidget is played, find Flaversham and play him to Flaversham's Toy Shop.

villain.name: Fidget's List
villain.text: Activate: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an Item. Put that Item into your hand. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Royal Robes
villain.text: Activate: Gain 2 Power.

villain.name: The Robot Queen
villain.text:
The Robot Queen can only be played to The Secret Lair.
If The Robot Queen is discarded from your Realm, flip over your Objective to reveal The Rat.

villain.name: Tools
villain.text: The Cost to play Items is reduced by 1 Power.

fate.name: Queen's Guards
fate.text: Queen's Guards can only be played to Buckingham Palace.

fate.name: Call for Help
fate.text: If Basil is in Ratigan's Realm, you may move him to any location. Otherwise, find Basil and play him to any location.

fate.name: Sabotage
fate.text: Discard an Item with a Cost of 3 or less from a location in Ratigan's Realm that has a Hero.

fate.name: Basil
fate.text: When Basil is played or moved, you may discard one Item from his new location.

fate.name: Dawson
fate.text: Dawson gets +2 Strength if Basil is in Ratigan's Realm.

fate.name: Flaversham
fate.text: If Flaversham is at The Secret Lair, the Cost to play The Robot Queen is reduced by 3 Power.

fate.name: Makeshift Balloon
fate.text: When Makeshift Balloon is played, attach it to a Hero. That Hero gets +2 Strength and you may immediately move that Hero to any location.

fate.name: Mrs. Judson
fate.text: When Mrs. Judson is played, Ratigan loses up to 2 Power.

fate.name: Olivia
fate.text: When Olivia is defeated, choose an opponent. That opponent reveals and plays the top card of your Fate deck.

fate.name: The Mouse Queen
fate.text: Ratigan cannot win with The Robot Queen at Buckingham Palace.

fate.name: Toby
fate.text: When Toby is played, you may move a Hero to any location.

villain.name: Hungry Hyena
villain.text: Hungry Hyena gets +1 Strength for each other Hyena at her location.

villain.name: Long Live the King
villain.text: Reveal the top four cards of your Fate deck. You may play one Hero. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Be Prepared
villain.text: Discard the top three cards of your deck. You may choose one Effect or up to two Allies from your discard pile and put them into your hand.

villain.name: Stick with Me
villain.text: Choose a Hyena who is not at Scar's location. You may perform one available action at that Hyena's location. You cannot use Stick with Me to perform Fate actions.

villain.name: Whisper
villain.text: Choose a card from your Fate discard pile and play it.

villain.name: Feeding Frenzy
villain.text: Choose a location and move any number of Hyenas in your Realm to that location.

villain.name: Injustice
villain.text: During their turn, if another player targets you with a Fate action, you may play Injustice. Before they reveal cards, look at the top two cards of your Fate deck. Either discard or return each to the top of the deck.

villain.name: Pride
villain.text: During their turn, if another player discards two or more cards, you may play Pride. Gain 3 Power.

villain.name: Stampede
villain.text: If Stampede is played to a location that has a Hero, move one Hero at that location to an adjacent location. Then you may perform a Vanquish action at the Hero's new location.

villain.name: Banzai the Hyena
villain.text: Gain 1 Power for each other Hyena discarded from Banzai's location.

villain.name: Ed the Hyena
villain.text: The Cost to play Hyenas to Ed's location is reduced by 1 Power.

villain.name: Shenzi the Hyena
villain.text: When Shenzi is played, you may play a Hyena from your hand for free.

fate.name: Hakuna Matata
fate.text: Either choose a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less from the Succession pile and play that Hero, or move a Hero to any location.

fate.name: Prophecy
fate.text: When Prophecy is played, attach it to a Hero with no other attached Items. That Hero gets +3 Strength.

fate.name: Mufasa
fate.text: When Mufasa is defeated, put him into the Succession pile. If Mufasa is in the Succession pile, all Heroes you defeat are put into the Succession pile.

fate.name: Nala
fate.text: When Nala is played, you may move a Hero to any location.

fate.name: Pumbaa
fate.text: Pumbaa gets +2 Strength if Timon is in Scar's Realm.

fate.name: Rafiki
fate.text: Scar must defeat Rafiki before defeating other Heroes.

fate.name: Rafiki's Stick
fate.text: When Rafiki's Stick is played, attach it to a Hero. When that Hero would be defeated, discard this Item instead.

fate.name: Sarabi
fate.text: When Sarabi is played, you may discard a Hyena from her location.

fate.name: Simba
fate.text: Hyenas cannot have a Strength of more than 2.

fate.name: Timon
fate.text: Timon gets +2 Strength if Pumbaa is in Scar's Realm.

fate.name: Zazu
fate.text: All other Heroes at Zazu's location get -2 Strength. All Heroes at other locations get +1 Strength.

villain.name: After Them!
villain.text: Choose one of your Fate decks. Reveal all the cards. Play all revealed Heroes to that location. Shuffle and return the rest.

villain.name: Eavesdrop
villain.text: Choose one of your Fate decks. Look at all the cards. Shuffle and return them.

villain.name: Imperial Guards
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Smash It with a Hammer
villain.text: Choose one of your Fate decks. Reveal two random cards and discard them.

villain.name: A Cruel Irony
villain.text: If there is an Ally at your location, choose an Effect from your discard pile, pay its Cost, and play it.

villain.name: Beauty Sleep
villain.text:
Beauty Sleep can only be played as the first and only action performed on your turn.
Before Yzma moves on your next turn, you may gain 2 Power, draw two cards, and move a Hero to an adjacent space.

villain.name: Fake Funeral
villain.text: Gain 1 Power for each Hero in your Fate discard pile, up to 5 Power total.

villain.name: Ferocity
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 3 or more, you may play Ferocity. Defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less.

villain.name: Finish the Job
villain.text: Move an Ally to any location that has a Hero.

villain.name: Right-Hand Man
villain.text: Find Kronk. Discard all Power on him. Put him and any Items attached to him into your hand.

villain.name: Superiority
villain.text: During their turn, if another player targets you with a Fate action, you may play Superiority. You choose which of your Fate decks they must look at.

villain.name: The Path That Rocks
villain.text: Discard all Power on Kronk. Gain that much Power.

villain.name: Dagger
villain.text: When Dagger is played, attach it to an Ally. That Ally gets +1 Strength. When Dagger would be discarded, put it into your hand instead.

villain.name: Kronk
villain.text:
Kronk is not discarded when he is used to defeat a Hero.
When Kronk is moved, put 1 Power from the Supply on him. When there are 3 or more Power on him, put him at the top of your Board. He is treated as a Hero.

fate.name: Beware the Groove
fate.text: Choose a Hero from Yzma's Fate discard pile. Shuffle that Hero and up to two of Yzma's Fate decks together. Deal the cards as evenly as possible to replace the shuffled Fate decks.

fate.name: Peasant
fate.text: When Peasant is played, you may choose a Hero from Yzma's Fate discard pile and shuffle that Hero into one of her Fate decks.

fate.name: The Path of Righteousness
fate.text: If Kuzco is in Yzma's Realm, place 2 Power on Kronk. Otherwise, place 1 Power on Kronk.

fate.name: Wrong Lever
fate.text:
When Wrong Lever is revealed, you must immediately play it.
Yzma loses half her Power, rounded up.

fate.name: Bucky
fate.text: Kronk cannot be used to defeat Bucky.

fate.name: Chaca
fate.text: Yzma cannot defeat other Heroes if Chaca or Tipo is in her Realm.

fate.name: Chicha
fate.text: If Yzma moves to Chicha's location, she immediately loses 2 Power.

fate.name: Kuzco
fate.text: If Kuzco is discarded, shuffle him and all Yzma's Fate decks together. Deal the cards as evenly as possible to form four new Fate decks.

fate.name: On the Run
fate.text: Choose a Hero in Yzma's Realm. Shuffle that Hero and all Yzma's Fate decks together. Deal the cards as evenly as possible to form four new Fate decks.

fate.name: Pacha
fate.text: When Pacha is played, you may shuffle two of Yzma's Fate decks together. Deal the cards as evenly as possible to replace the shuffled Fate decks.

fate.name: Tipo
fate.text: Yzma cannot defeat other Heroes if Tipo or Chaca is in her Realm.

villain.name: I Live for Furs
villain.text: Gain 1 Power for each location in your Realm that has at least one Puppy Token.

villain.name: Cruel
villain.text: During their turn, if another player moves an Ally or Item, you may play Cruel. Choose one Puppy Token from the Supply and add it to the specified location.

villain.name: Devilish
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 3 or more, you may play Devilish. Defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less.

villain.name: Fireplace Poker
villain.text: When Fireplace Poker is played, attach it to an Ally. That Ally gets +1 Strength. When that Ally would be discarded, discard this Item instead.

villain.name: Flashlight
villain.text: Activate: Choose a Puppy Token from the Supply and add it to the specified location.

villain.name: Get the Job Done
villain.text: Perform an Activate action.

villain.name: Here, Puppies
villain.text: Choose a Puppy Token from the Supply and add it to the specified location.

villain.name: Spotted
villain.text: Reveal up to two Puppy Tokens in the Supply.

villain.name: That Devil Woman
villain.text: Move a Hero to any location.

villain.name: The Devil Take It
villain.text: Choose an Item or Effect from your discard pile and put it into your hand.

villain.name: Whatever It Takes
villain.text: On this turn, you may perform one action that is covered by a Hero at your location.

villain.name: You Idiots!
villain.text: Either move an Ally to your location, or choose an Ally from your deck or discard pile and put them into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

villain.name: Bought and Paid For
villain.text: Capture one Puppy Token from Cruella De Vil's location.

villain.name: Horace
villain.text: Activate: Either capture one Puppy Token at this location, or choose one Puppy Token from the Supply and add it to the specified location.

villain.name: Jasper
villain.text: Activate: Pay 1 Power. Capture up to two Puppy Tokens at this location.

villain.name: Roadster
villain.text: When Roadster is moved, you may move it to any location. You may move up to two Puppy Tokens from Roadster's previous location to its new location.

villain.name: Telephone
villain.text: Activate: Pay 1 Power. Choose an Ally from your discard pile and play them to any location for free.

fate.name: Flew the Coop
fate.text: Choose one captured Puppy Token and return it face up to the Supply.

fate.name: Reckless Driving
fate.text: Discard an Item from Cruella De Vil's Realm.

fate.name: Twilight Bark
fate.text: Choose and play a Hero from Cruella De Vil's Fate discard pile.

fate.name: We're Labradors
fate.text: Remove up to two Puppy Tokens from one location and return them face up to the Supply.

fate.name: Anita and Roger
fate.text: When a Puppy Token from the Supply would be added to this location, return it face up to the Supply.

fate.name: Captain
fate.text: When Captain is played, you may move an Ally from his location to an adjacent location.

fate.name: Colonel
fate.text: When Colonel is played, you may move a Hero to any location.

fate.name: Nanny
fate.text: The Cost to activate Allies and Items at this location is increased by 1 Power.

fate.name: Perdita
fate.text: When Perdita is played, you may choose one captured Puppy Token and add it to her location.

fate.name: Pongo
fate.text: Puppy Tokens cannot be captured at this location.

fate.name: Sergeant Tibbs
fate.text: When Sergeant Tibbs is played, you may move up to two Puppy Tokens in Cruella De Vil's Realm to his location.

villain.name: Royal Guard
villain.text: When Royal Guard is moved, you may move a Hero from Royal Guard's previous location to his new location.

villain.name: Duplicity
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 3 or more, you may play Duplicity. Defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less.

villain.name: Egomania
villain.text: During their turn, if another player moves an Ally or Item, you may play Egomania. Move Rapunzel to Rapunzel's Tower.

villain.name: I Love You Most
villain.text: If Mother Gothel and Rapunzel are at the same location, gain 1 Trust. If Mother Gothel and Rapunzel are at Rapunzel's Tower, gain 1 additional Trust.

villain.name: Let Down Your Hair
villain.text: If Rapunzel is at Rapunzel's Tower, gain 1 Trust. Otherwise, move Rapunzel up to two locations toward Rapunzel's Tower.

villain.name: Misdirection
villain.text: Move Rapunzel one location toward Corona and gain 1 Trust.

villain.name: Mother Knows Best
villain.text: At the end of this turn, do not move Rapunzel.

villain.name: Now I'm the Bad Guy
villain.text: Move Rapunzel to Rapunzel's Tower and lose 1 Trust.

villain.name: Revenge
villain.text: Perform a Vanquish action. If you defeat a Hero other than Rapunzel, gain 1 Trust.

villain.name: Royal Rider
villain.text: When performing a Vanquish action, Royal Rider may be used to defeat a Hero at his location or at an adjacent location.

villain.name: What Once Was Mine
villain.text: Choose a card from your discard pile and put it into your hand.

villain.name: Crown
villain.text: When a Hero is defeated at this location, either gain 2 Power or discard Crown to gain 1 Trust.

villain.name: Hair Brush
villain.text: When Hair Brush is played or moved to Rapunzel's location, gain 1 Trust.

villain.name: Knife
villain.text: When Knife is played, attach it to an Ally. That Ally gets +2 Strength. When that Ally is used to defeat Rapunzel, gain 1 Trust.

villain.name: Patchy Stabbington
villain.text: When Patchy Stabbington is played to Rapunzel's location, you may move Rapunzel to Rapunzel's Tower.

villain.name: Sideburns Stabbington
villain.text: When Sideburns Stabbington is played to Rapunzel's location, you may move Rapunzel to Rapunzel's Tower.

fate.name: Everyone Has a Dream
fate.text: Mother Gothel loses 1 Trust.

fate.name: Aging
fate.text: Discard an Ally or Item with a Cost of 2 or less from Mother Gothel's Realm.

fate.name: Floating Lights
fate.text: Move Rapunzel to Corona.

fate.name: Flynn Rider
fate.text: When Flynn Rider is played, Mother Gothel loses 2 Trust. When Flynn Rider is defeated, Mother Gothel gains 2 Trust.

fate.name: Frying Pan
fate.text: When Frying Pan is played, attach it to a Hero. That Hero gets +1 Strength.

fate.name: Hook Hand
fate.text: When Hook Hand is played, Mother Gothel discards a random card from her hand.

fate.name: Maximus
fate.text: When Maximus is played, you may move a Royal Rider at his location to any other location.

fate.name: Pascal
fate.text: When Rapunzel moves to Pascal's location, move her one location toward Corona.

fate.name: Queen and King
fate.text: If Queen and King are played to Rapunzel's location, Mother Gothel loses 1 Trust.

fate.name: Shorty
fate.text: If Shorty is played to Mother Gothel's location, you may move Mother Gothel to any location.

fate.name: Ulf
fate.text: Allies may not be moved from Ulf's location.

extra.title: Tile
extra.note: Not in the Fate deck: Rapunzel starts on a tile and is played to Mother Gothel's Realm at the start of the game.

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.text: At the end of Mother Gothel's turn, move Rapunzel one location toward Corona. If Rapunzel is already at Corona, Mother Gothel loses 1 Trust. When Rapunzel is defeated, move her to Rapunzel's Tower.

villain.name: Bandit
villain.text: You may play any number of Bandits as part of the same Play a Card action.

villain.name: Play a Game
villain.text: Reveal the top two cards of your deck. Gain Power equal to the sum of their Costs, then discard them.

villain.name: Horse
villain.text: When Horse is played, you may move an Ally or Item in your Realm to any location.

villain.name: Parrot
villain.text: When Parrot is played, choose a card from your discard pile and put it into your hand.

villain.name: Sneaky Pete
villain.text: Draw two cards into your hand, then put one card from your hand on the top or bottom of your deck.

villain.name: Mischief
villain.text: During their turn, if another player gains 3 or more Power, you may play Mischief. Draw two cards from the bottom of your deck, then put one card from your hand on the top or bottom of your deck.

villain.name: Outrage
villain.text: During their turn, if another player moves an Ally or Item, you may play Outrage. Defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less.

villain.name: Air Strike!
villain.text: Move Pete to any location with a Hero and defeat them, then end your turn.

villain.name: Bank Loot
villain.text:
Bank Loot can only be played to Frontier Town.
This location gains: Gain 1 Power action.

villain.name: Cricket
villain.text: Each time a Hero is played to your Realm, you may move Cricket to that Hero's location.

villain.name: Jalopy
villain.text:
Bank Loot can only be played to Service Station.
This location gains: Play a Card action.

villain.name: Steamboat Willie
villain.text:
Steamboat Willie can only be played to Podunk Landing.
This location gains: Move an Item or Ally action.

villain.name: Stolen Cargo
villain.text:
Stolen Cargo can only be played to The Airport.
This location gains: Gain 1 Power action.

fate.name: Hide
fate.text: Discard a Bandit from Pete's Realm.

fate.name: Knocked Silly
fate.text: Reveal the top five cards of Pete's deck. Discard the cards with a Cost of 2 or more, and return the rest to the top of the deck in random order.

fate.name: Outlawed
fate.text: Pete loses up to 2 Power. You may reveal one Goal Token in Pete's Realm.

fate.name: Clarabelle Cow
fate.text: When Clarabelle Cow is played, you may reveal one Goal Token that is face down.

fate.name: Donald Duck
fate.text: Pete must defeat Donald Duck before defeating other Heroes.

fate.name: Goofy
fate.text: When Goofy is played, you may switch the locations of two adjacent Goal Tokens, or move one Goal Token to an adjacent location without a Goal Token.

fate.name: Horace Horsecollar
fate.text: When Horace Horsecollar is played, you may move an Ally or Item to any location.

fate.name: Mickey Mouse
fate.text: Pete cannot complete Goals.

fate.name: Minnie Mouse
fate.text: When Minnie Mouse is played, you may discard an Ally or Item from Pete's Realm.

fate.name: Oswald the Lucky Rabbit
fate.text: The amount of Power that Pete gains from Play a Game is reduced by 1 Power.

fate.name: Pluto
fate.text: When Pluto is played, you may move an Item in Pete's Realm to Pluto's location.

fate.name: Tired
fate.text: Pete loses half his Power, rounded down.

villain.name: Wolves
villain.text: Wolves gain +1 Strength for every other Wolves card in play.

villain.name: Beautiful as Me
villain.text: During their turn, if another player takes four or more actions, you may play Beautiful as Me. You may remove one Obstacle Token.

villain.name: Swoon
villain.text: Replace one Obstacle. Then either gain 3 Power or draw 3 Cards.

villain.name: Belle Is Mine
villain.text: Perform a Vanquish action.

villain.name: Come Into the Light
villain.text: Remove up to two Obstacles from a single location.

villain.name: Five Dozen Eggs
villain.text: When Five Dozen Eggs is played, attach it to an Ally. That Ally gains +2 Strength.

villain.name: Hunter's Instinct
villain.text: Defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less.

villain.name: Intimidating
villain.text: Reveal cards from the top of your Villain deck until you reveal an Ally. Put that Ally in your hand. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Take Me Instead
villain.text: Reveal cards from your Fate deck until you find a Hero, then play that Hero to Beast's Castle. Remove one Obstacle.

villain.name: Time to Follow Me!
villain.text: Perform a Move Item or Ally action.

villain.name: Get Out!
villain.text: Remove three Obstacles.

villain.name: Lefou
villain.text: When performing a Vanquish action in Lefou's location, all Allies are returned to your hand instead of the discard pile.

villain.name: Monsieur D'Arque
villain.text: Activate: Pay 2 Power. Remove one Obstacle.

villain.name: Show Me the Beast!
villain.text: If Beast is in play, remove one Obstacle. If Belle is in play, replace one Obstacle. If both are in play, gain 2 Power.

villain.name: Temper
villain.text: Remove one Obstacle.

villain.name: The Mob
villain.text: No additional Ability.

fate.name: Be Our Guest
fate.text: Find a Hero in the Fate discard pile and play them to any location.

fate.name: Beast
fate.text: When Beast is played or moved, move any Allies out of Beast's location to any other location. When Beast is defeated, remove all Obstacles from Beast's Castle.

fate.name: Belle
fate.text: No Obstacles can be removed while Belle is in play.

fate.name: Cogsworth
fate.text: All other Heroes in Cogsworth's location gain +1 Strength.

fate.name: It Is You
fate.text: Replace one Obstacle in each location.

fate.name: I've Never Seen So Many Books
fate.text: Replace one Obstacle.

fate.name: Lumiere
fate.text: When Lumiere is played, you may move a Hero to a new location.

fate.name: Magic Mirror
fate.text: Find and play Beast. Shuffle the Fate discard pile, including Magic Mirror, back into the Fate deck.

fate.name: Massaging My Feet
fate.text: Replace two Obstacles.

fate.name: Maurice
fate.text: When Maurice is played, find and play Maurice's Invention to Maurice's location. If Maurice is defeated, remove all Obstacles from Belle's House.

fate.name: Maurice's Invention
fate.text: All Allies in the same location as Maurice's Invention lose 1 Strength.

fate.name: Mrs. Potts and Chip
fate.text: When Mrs. Potts and Chip is played, you may move all Heroes or Fate Items to new locations.

fate.name: Saving My Life
fate.text: Replace all Obstacles in a single location.

fate.name: The Rose
fate.text: Play the other Fate card you have drawn. Discard The Rose and pick two more Fate cards. Play one. Remove one Obstacle.

villain.name: Ancient Soldiers
villain.text: This location gains: Activate action.

villain.name: Cauldron Born
villain.text: Cauldron Born may only be played when The Power of The Black Cauldron is showing. Do not discard if used in a Vanquish action.

villain.name: Horned King's Henchmen
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Gwythaints
villain.text: When performing a Vanquish action, Gwythaints may be used to defeat a Hero at their location or at an adjacent location.

villain.name: Only Moments Away From Victory
villain.text: During their turn, if another player plays an Item, you may play Only Moments Away From Victory. Play an Item from your hand for 0 cost.

villain.name: Our Hour Has Arrived
villain.text: Flip The Black Cauldron to The Power of the Black Cauldron.

villain.name: Show Me the Black Cauldron
villain.text: Either claim The Black Cauldron or gain 3 Power.

villain.name: Visions
villain.text: Gain Power equal to the number of Heroes in your Realm.

villain.name: We Got You Now, Pig Keeper
villain.text: Either find and play Hen Wen or defeat a Hero with a Strength of 1.

villain.name: We Have Made a Bargain
villain.text: Either shuffle your Villain discard pile back into your deck or pay 3 additional Power, discard Dyrnwyn and claim The Black Cauldron.

villain.name: Captured!
villain.text: Draw three cards.

villain.name: Creeper
villain.text: When used in a Vanquish action, do not discard Creeper. Instead, move him to the Horned King's location.

villain.name: Guard Dog
villain.text: Gain +1 Strength if at a location with another Ally.

fate.name: I Believe in You
fate.text: The Horned King must discard his hand, then draw three cards from his Villain deck.

fate.name: Reunited
fate.text: Search the Horned King's Fate discard pile and play a Hero from it.

fate.name: Doli
fate.text: When Doli is played, you may move each Hero in the Horned King's Realm to any other location.

fate.name: Dyrnwyn
fate.text: When Dyrnwyn is played, attach it to a Hero. When performing a Vanquish action against that Hero, at least two Allies must be used.

fate.name: Fair Folk
fate.text: Ancient Soldiers cannot be played to this location.

fate.name: Fflewddur Fflam
fate.text: When Fflewddur Fflam is played, move all Allies to his location.

fate.name: Gurgi
fate.text: When Gurgi is defeated in a Vanquish action, shuffle him back into the Horned King's Fate deck.

fate.name: Gurgi's Happy Day
fate.text: Shuffle all discarded Fate cards back into the Horned King's Fate deck. Draw two new Fate cards and play them both.

fate.name: Gurgi's Sacrifice
fate.text: If The Power of the Black Cauldron is face up, flip it over.

fate.name: Hen Wen
fate.text: While Hen Wen is in play, the Horned King cannot play Effect cards. When Hen Wen is defeated, the Horned King claims The Black Cauldron.

fate.name: Princess Eilonwy
fate.text: All other Heroes in the Horned King's Realm gain +1 Strength.

fate.name: Taran
fate.text: Gain +1 Strength for every other Hero at Taran's location.

fate.name: The Witches of Morva
fate.text: When The Witches of Morva are played, the Horned King must immediately either lose 2 Power or discard two cards from his hand.

extra.title: Tile
extra.note: Two-sided tile, set aside at the start: The Black Cauldron on one side, The Power of the Black Cauldron on the other. Claim it to put it next to the Villain portrait.

cards.name: The Black Cauldron
cards.text:
At the start of your turn, discard one Cauldron Born from any location.
Activate: Flip this tile to The Power of the Black Cauldron.

back.name: The Power of the Black Cauldron
back.text: On your turn, before you move, you may pay 2 Power to replace an Ancient Soldier in play with a Cauldron Born from your hand. You may only do this once per turn.

villain.name: There's Still a Chance
villain.text: Choose one: Move an Item or Ally action or Activate action.

villain.name: I Said "If"
villain.text: Shuffle your Villain discard pile back into your deck. Draw two cards.

villain.name: Trapped
villain.text: Place a Trapped token on a Hero in your Realm.

villain.name: And One More Thing
villain.text: During their turn, if another player takes a Discard action, you may play And One More Thing. Discard any number of cards and draw back up to four cards.

villain.name: I Never Go Back on My Word
villain.text: Shuffle your Fate discard pile back into your Fate deck. Look at the top four Fate cards and replace them in any order.

villain.name: Locked Up
villain.text: During their turn, if another player takes a Vanquish action, you may play Locked Up. You may place a Trapped Token on any Hero in your Realm.

villain.name: Vicious Practical Jokes
villain.text: During their turn, if another player targets you with a Fate action, you may play Vicious Practical Jokes. Of the two Fate cards chosen, you pick which card is played and where.

villain.name: You Little Thief!
villain.text: Defeat Cinderella or Ball Gown Cinderella.

villain.name: Anastasia
villain.text: Discard Anastasia from your Realm to play Ball Gown Anastasia. Anastasia may not be played if Ball Gown Anastasia is in play.

villain.name: Ball Gown Anastasia
villain.text: You must discard Anastasia from your Realm to play Ball Gown Anastasia.

villain.name: Ball Gown Drizella
villain.text: You must discard Drizella from your Realm to play Ball Gown Drizella.

villain.name: Drizella
villain.text: Discard Drizella from your Realm to play Ball Gown Drizella. Drizella may not be played if Ball Gown Drizella is in play.

villain.name: Invitation from the King
villain.text:
When Invitation from the King is played, unlock The Ballroom. If The Prince is not in play, find and play him to The Ballroom.
Activate: Look at the top two cards of your Fate deck. Discard one and leave the other face down on top.

villain.name: Lady Tremaine's Cane
villain.text: Activate: Remove a Glass Slipper.

villain.name: Lucifer
villain.text: Place a Trapped token on a Hero in Lucifer's location.

villain.name: Midnight
villain.text: Defeat all Heroes in your Realm. Find and play both Glass Slippers.

villain.name: The Key
villain.text:
When The Key is played, move Cinderella to Cinderella's Room. Put a Trapped token on her.
Activate: Move any Hero to Cinderella's Room and put a Trapped token on them.

villain.name: Wedding Bells
villain.text: Activate: Can only be Activated when The Prince and either Ball Gown Anastasia or Ball Gown Drizella are in The Ballroom and no Glass Slippers are in play. Activate this card to win the game!

fate.name: Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Boo
fate.text: Remove a Trapped token from any Hero, then move that Hero to a new location.

fate.name: Sweet Nightingale
fate.text: Move an Ally to any location.

fate.name: Glass Slipper
fate.text: This Glass Slipper does not attach to a Hero and must be played to Cinderella's Room/The Castle. Lady Tremaine cannot win the game while a Glass Slipper is in her Realm.
fate.versions: 2 versions: one for Cinderella's Room, one for The Castle.

fate.name: Ball Gown Cinderella
fate.text: Discard Cinderella to play Ball Gown Cinderella. While Ball Gown Cinderella is in play, no Allies may enter The Ballroom. This card cannot be Trapped. When Ball Gown Cinderella is defeated, find both Glass Slippers and play them.

fate.name: Bruno
fate.text: When Bruno is played or moved, move Lucifer to his location.

fate.name: Cinderella
fate.text: While Cinderella is in play, all Effect cards cost +2 Power. Cinderella may not be played if Ball Gown Cinderella is in play.

fate.name: Fairy Godmother
fate.text: When Fairy Godmother is played, find and play Ball Gown Cinderella. While Fairy Godmother is in play, only Fate cards can move Allies.

fate.name: Gus
fate.text: While Gus is in play, all Item cards cost +2 Power.

fate.name: Jaq
fate.text: When Jaq is played or moved, discard one Item from his new location.

fate.name: The Prince
fate.text: When The Prince is revealed, you MUST PLAY HIM IMMEDIATELY to The Ballroom, even if it is locked.

villain.name: Locked Up
villain.text: All Heroes in the Caterpillar Room get -1 Strength.

villain.name: Not Age Appropriate
villain.text: Move a Hero in your Realm or any Buzz Lightyear to the Caterpillar Room.

villain.name: Something Snapped
villain.text: During their turn, if another player discards one or more cards, you may play Something Snapped. Move all Heroes to the Caterpillar Room.

villain.name: The Bookworm
villain.text: Pay any amount of Power to play The Bookworm. Reduce a Hero's Strength by that amount.

villain.name: Welcome to Sunnyside
villain.text: Reveal cards from the top of your Fate deck until you reveal a Hero. Play that Hero to the Caterpillar Room. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Original Factory Settings
villain.text: Flip Buzz Lightyear to Demo Mode Buzz Lightyear and move him to any location at the bottom of Lotso's Realm. All Heroes lose 1 Strength.

villain.name: Patrolling All Night Long
villain.text: Choose a Hero who is not at the Caterpillar Room. That Hero gets -1 Strength.

villain.name: Smells Like Strawberries
villain.text: During their turn, if another player takes a Fate action, you may play Smells Like Strawberries. Shuffle your discard pile back into your deck.

villain.name: Where's Your Kid Now?
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 2 or more, you may play Where's Your Kid Now?. Choose a Hero at Lotso's location and reduce their Strength to 0.

villain.name: Big Baby
villain.text: Activate: Reveal cards from the top of your Fate deck until you reveal a Hero. Play that Hero to any location except the Caterpillar Room.

villain.name: Chunk
villain.text: Chunk gets +1 Strength if Sparks is in Lotso's Realm.

villain.name: New Toys Don't Stand a Chance
villain.text: All Heroes in the Caterpillar Room lose Strength equal to the number of Heroes in the Caterpillar Room.

villain.name: Sparks
villain.text: Sparks gets +1 Strength if Twitch is in Lotso's Realm.

villain.name: Stretch
villain.text: Activate: Move a Hero or Guardian in Stretch's location to any location in Lotso's Realm.

villain.name: Twitch
villain.text: Twitch gets +1 Strength if Chunk is in Lotso's Realm.

villain.name: Woody's Hat
villain.text: All Heroes in Lotso's Realm except Woody get -1 Strength.

fate.name: Bonnie's Toys
fate.text: Choose a Hero with reduced Strength and remove all Strength reduction tokens from that Hero.

fate.name: One Way Out
fate.text: Move a Hero in the Caterpillar Room to any other location.

fate.name: Spanish Mode
fate.text:
Flip Buzz Lightyear to his Guardian side and move him to the top side of Lotso's Realm at The Playground/
Tricounty Landfill. If Jessie is in Lotso's Realm, she gains 1 Strength.
fate.versions: 2 versions: one for The Playground, one for Tricounty Landfill.

fate.name: The Claw
fate.text: Choose a Hero with 0 Strength in Lotso's Realm. Discard that Hero, removing all Strength tokens, then shuffle Lotso's Fate discard pile back into his Fate deck.

fate.name: Andy's Looking For Us
fate.text: All Heroes with 1 or more Strength get +2 Strength. Heroes with 0 Strength are not affected.

fate.name: Daisy's Locket
fate.text: When Daisy's Locket is played, discard Big Baby. Shuffle Lotso's Fate discard pile into his Fate deck.

fate.name: Hamm
fate.text: When performing a Vanquish action to defeat Hamm, at least two Allies must be used.

fate.name: Jessie
fate.text: When Jessie is played, you may discard any Ally from Lotso's Realm.

fate.name: Lotso Was Special
fate.text: Discard an Ally from Lotso's Realm.

fate.name: Rex
fate.text: When performing a Vanquish action, Rex cannot be targeted if there are other Heroes in his location. Rex cannot lose Strength if other Heroes are in his location.

fate.name: Woody
fate.text: When Woody is played, you may move all Heroes in the Caterpillar Room to any other locations. If Woody's Hat is in Lotso's Realm, discard it.

extra.title: Tile
extra.note: Two-sided tile: Buzz Lightyear, a Guardian that starts at Caterpillar Room, on one side; Demo Mode Buzz Lightyear, an Ally, on the other.

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.text: Neither Buzz Lightyear nor any Heroes in his location can be targeted by Vanquish actions.

villain.name: I'm Not Cheating
villain.text: Look at the top two cards of the Merlin Transformation deck. Return them to the top of the Merlin Transformation deck in any order.

villain.name: A Sporting Chance
villain.text: During their turn, if another player performs a Vanquish action, you may play A Sporting Chance. Choose any card from your discard pile and put it into your hand.

villain.name: As Big as a House
villain.text: During their turn, if another player gains 2 or more Power, you may play As Big as a House. Gain 2 Power.

villain.name: Battle of Wits
villain.text: Draw four cards from your deck. Then, discard four cards from your hand.

villain.name: I'll Make the Rules
villain.text: Defeat any Merlin Transformation in Madam Mim's Realm.

villain.name: Magnificent, Marvelous, Mad
villain.text: Shuffle your discard pile back into your deck.

villain.name: Wizard's Duel
villain.text: Draw the top card from the Merlin Transformation deck and play it to the Dueling Ground.

villain.name: Chicken Mim
villain.text: Chicken Mim can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Caterpillar Merlin.

villain.name: Crocodile Mim
villain.text: Crocodile Mim can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Turtle Merlin.

villain.name: Elephant Mim
villain.text: Elephant Merlin can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Hippopotamus Mim.

villain.name: Fox Mim
villain.text: Fox Mim can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Rabbit Merlin.

villain.name: Purple Dragon Mim
villain.text: Purple Dragon Mim can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Goat Merlin.

villain.name: Rattlesnake Mim
villain.text: Rattlesnake Mim can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Mouse Merlin.

villain.name: Rhinoceros Mim
villain.text: Rhinoceros Mim can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Crab Merlin.

villain.name: Tiger Mim
villain.text: Tiger Mim can only be used in a Vanquish action targeting Mouse Mim.

fate.name: Knowledge and Wisdom
fate.text: Move any Merlin Transformation in Madam Mim's Realm to a new location.

fate.name: Archimedes
fate.text: Draw a Merlin Transformation and play it to the same location as another Merlin Transformation in Madam Mim's Realm. Shuffle the previously played Merlin Transformation in that location back into Merlin's deck.

fate.name: Bird Arthur
fate.text: Madam Mim discards her hand and draws two cards.

fate.name: Germ Merlin
fate.text: Discard one of Madam Mim's Transformations from Madam Mim's Realm.

fate.name: Merlin
fate.text: Randomly choose one card from the Merlin Transformation discard pile and put it back into the Merlin Transformation deck. Shuffle the Merlin Transformation deck.

cards.name: Caterpillar Merlin
cards.text: Caterpillar Merlin can only be defeated in a Vanquish action by Chicken Mim.

cards.name: Crab Merlin
cards.text: Crab Merlin can only be defeated in a Vanquish action by Rhinoceros Mim.

cards.name: Goat Merlin
cards.text: Goat Merlin can only be defeated in a Vanquish action by Purple Dragon Mim.

cards.name: Mouse Merlin
cards.text: Mouse Mim can only be defeated in a Vanquish action by Tiger Mim or Rattlesnake Mim.

cards.name: Rabbit Merlin
cards.text: Rabbit Merlin can only be defeated in a Vanquish action by Fox Mim.

cards.name: Turtle Merlin
cards.text: Turtle Merlin can only be defeated in a Vanquish action by Crocodile Mim.

cards.name: Walrus Merlin
cards.text: Walrus Merlin can only be defeated in a Vanquish action by Elephant Mim.

villain.name: Major Modifications
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: 15 Years Later
villain.text: During their turn, if another player gains any Power, you may play 15 Years Later. Reveal Fate cards until you reveal a Hero. Play that Hero to any location in your Realm. That Hero gets -2 Strength. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Guards
villain.text: Guards get +1 Strength for each other Ally at their location.

villain.name: Not a Sidekick
villain.text: During their turn, if another player discards one or more cards, you may play Not a Sidekick. Draw cards from your Villain deck equal to the number of cards discarded.

villain.name: Velocipod Patrol
villain.text: When performing a Vanquish action, Velocipod Patrol may be used to defeat a Hero at their location or at an adjacent location.

villain.name: Bio Probe
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero, you may play Bio Probe. Defeat a Hero of equal or lesser Strength than the one defeated by your opponent.

villain.name: Containment Unit
villain.text: Choose a Hero in your Realm. That Hero loses Strength equal to their current Strength.

villain.name: Identification Please
villain.text: Move an Ally or Omnidroid to any location with a Hero.

villain.name: Security
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Who's Super Now?
villain.text: During their turn, if another player takes a Play a Card action, you may play Who's Super Now?. Gain Power equal to the Cost of the card played by your opponent.

villain.name: Zero-Point Energy
villain.text: When Zero-Point Energy is played, attach it to a Hero. That Hero gets -2 Strength and cannot be moved.

villain.name: Mirage
villain.text: When Mirage is played, reveal cards from the top of Syndrome's Fate deck until you reveal a Hero. Play that Hero to Mirage's location. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Syndrome's Remote
villain.text:
This location gains: Activate action.
If Syndrome is in the same location as Omnidroid v.10, activate Syndrome's Remote to defeat Omnidroid v.10. After Omnidroid v.10 is defeated, flip the tile over.

fate.name: Force Field
fate.text: When Force Field is played, attach it to a Hero. When that Hero would be defeated, discard this Item instead.

fate.name: No Capes!
fate.text: Place No Capes! under Syndrome's mover. At the beginning of his next turn, Syndrome discards No Capes!, then remains in the same location and takes the actions there.

fate.name: Teamwork
fate.text: Play this card, then play the second Fate card you drew. Then, look at the top six cards of Syndrome's Fate deck. Return them to the top of Syndrome's Fate deck in any order.

fate.name: Dash
fate.text: If Syndrome's Remote is in Syndrome's Realm when Dash is played, attach it to Dash. When Dash is played, you may move any Hero in Syndrome's Realm to Dash's location.

fate.name: Elastigirl
fate.text: If Syndrome's Remote is in Syndrome's Realm when Elastigirl is played, attach it to Elastigirl. When Elastigirl is played, you may discard an Ally from her location.

fate.name: Frozone
fate.text: If Syndrome's Remote is in Syndrome's Realm when Frozone is played, attach it to Frozone. Allies cannot be moved away from Frozone's location.

fate.name: Infiltrate
fate.text: Syndrome must reveal his hand to all players.

fate.name: Jack-Jack
fate.text: When you play Jack-Jack, Jack-Jack gains Strength until his Strength is equal to the strongest Hero in his location.

fate.name: Mr. Incredible
fate.text: If Syndrome's Remote is in Syndrome's Realm when Mr. Incredible is played, attach it to Mr. Incredible. Mr. Incredible gets +1 Strength for each other Hero at his location.

fate.name: Monologuing
fate.text: Syndrome discards three cards from his hand.

fate.name: That Was Totally Wicked
fate.text: Discard all Allies and Items (except for Force Fields) from Syndrome's Realm.

fate.name: Violet
fate.text: If Syndrome's Remote is in Syndrome's Realm when Violet is played, attach it to Violet. When Violet is played, discard all Zero-Point Energy from Syndrome's Realm.

extra.title: Tiles
extra.note: Syndrome starts with Omnidroid v.X8 at Nomanisan Island and upgrades it to v.X9, then v.10. Omnidroid v.10 has a Destroyed side.

cards.name: Omnidroid v.X8
cards.text: When discarded as the result of a Vanquish action, remove Omnidroid v.X8 from your Realm. Shuffle your discard pile into your deck.

cards.name: Omnidroid v.X9
cards.text: Remove one Major Modification from your Realm to play this card to any location. When discarded as the result of a Vanquish action, remove Omnidroid v.X9 from your Realm. Find Syndrome's Remote and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Omnidroid v.10
cards.text: Remove three Major Modifications from your Realm to play Omnidroid v.10 to Downtown Metroville. If Syndrome's Remote is in your Realm, play Omnidroid v.10 to the opposite side of the Realm. Do not discard Omnidroid v.10 if used in a Vanquish action.

back.name: Omnidroid v.10 Destroyed
back.text: Omnidroid v.10 is defeated. If there are no Heroes in your Realm, you win the game.

villain.name: Impostor Sandy Claws
villain.text: When Impostor Sandy Claws is played, roll the dice: On a result of 7+, place this card next to Sandy Claws. If Jack Skellington is in play, reduce his Strength by 1 instead. On a result of 6 or less, discard this card.

villain.name: Bats
villain.text: When Bats is used in a Vanquish action, place Bats in the discard pile. Search the discard pile for an Ally and place that Ally in Oogie Boogie's hand.

villain.name: Loaded Dice
villain.text: You may play Loaded Dice immediately after you have rolled the dice (no Play a Card action needed). Reroll one die and discard this card.

villain.name: Making Christmastime
villain.text: Roll the dice. On a result of 8+, perform any available non-Fate action in Oogie Boogie's Realm. On a result of 7 or less, draw a card.

villain.name: Spiders
villain.text: When Spiders are used to defeat a Hero, gain 1 Power and draw one card.

villain.name: Trick or Treat
villain.text: During their turn, if another player gains Power, you may play Trick or Treat. Roll the dice. On a result of 8+, Oogie Boogie gains that same power. On a result of 7 or less, take 1 Power from any player.

villain.name: What Did Santa Bring You?
villain.text: During their turn, if another player takes a Play a Card action, you may play What Did Santa Bring You? You may discard any number of cards in your hand and draw two cards.

villain.name: What Have We Here?
villain.text: Perform a Vanquish action. Then, roll the dice. On a result of 8+, do not discard the Allies used to defeat the Hero. On a result of 7 or less, put the Allies into your hand.

villain.name: Barrel
villain.text: Barrel gets +1 Strength when Shock is in play. Barrel gets +1 Strength when Lock is in play. When Oogie Boogie rolls the dice at Barrel's location, increase the result by 1.

villain.name: Bathtub
villain.text:
This location gains: Activate action.
Activate to move Bathtub to a new location, then move any number of Allies to that location.

villain.name: It's a Vacation
villain.text: Discard the top three Fate cards. Draw one Villain card for each Hero discarded.

villain.name: Lock
villain.text: Lock gets +1 Strength when Shock is in play. Lock gets +1 Strength when Barrel is in play. Allies cost 1 less Power to play.

villain.name: Shock
villain.text: Shock gets +1 Strength when Lhock is in play. Shock gets +1 Strength when Barrel is in play. When Oogie Boogie moves to Shock's location, draw a card.

villain.name: This Time, We Bagged Him
villain.text: Choose and play an Effect from Oogie Boogie's discard pile for free. If you need to roll dice, you choose the result.

fate.name: Citizens of Halloween Town
fate.text: Oogie Boogie must defeat Citizens of Halloween Town before you defeat any other Hero in their location.

fate.name: Distraction
fate.text: Move a Hero to an adjacent location. You may discard an Ally or Item from that Hero's new location.

fate.name: Hello, Oogie!
fate.text: Place Hello, Oogie! under Oogie Boogie's mover. Next time, after Oogie Boogie rolls dice, discard Hello, Oogie! and reduce the result by 2.

fate.name: Doctor Finkelstein
fate.text: When Doctor Finkelstein is defeated, place him on the top of the Fate deck and shuffle it.

fate.name: Jack Skellington
fate.text: When Jack Skellington is played from the Fate deck, Jack Skellington is an Effect that discards an Impostor Sandy Claws. Otherwise, Jack Skellington is a Hero with no additional Ability.

fate.name: Sally
fate.text: When Sally is played, move Oogie Boogie to her location. While Sally is in play, Oogie Boogie can only move to adjacent locations.

fate.name: Sandy Claws
fate.text: When there are four Impostor Sandy Claws in a pile next to Sandy Claws, find Jack Skellington and place him at Oogie Boogie's Lair. Remove Sandy Claws from the game.

fate.name: Set Things Right
fate.text: Oogie Boogie must reveal his hand. Choose one card to remove.

fate.name: The Mayor of Halloween Town
fate.text: When The Mayor of Halloween Town is defeated, reveal Fate cards until you find a Hero. Play that Hero to any location.

fate.name: Zero
fate.text: Jack Skellington gets +2 Strength while Zero is in play.

villain.name: Candy Cy-Bug
villain.text: Candy Cy-Bug is not discarded after use in a Vanquish action. Instead, increase its Strength by 1 and move it to a new location.

villain.name: Glitch
villain.text: When Glitch is played, attach it to Vanellope von Schweetz. If a Glitch is already attached, move King Candy and the Racer token forward two action spaces. If no other Glitch is attached, place the Racer token and King Candy's mover on Start/Finish. End your turn.

villain.name: Go!
villain.text: You may move up to two Allies to new locations.

villain.name: Locked Up Memories
villain.text: Either gain 3 Power or move the Racer token back two action spaces.

villain.name: Racers
villain.text: When Racers is played or moved, gain 1 Power.

villain.name: Turbo-Tastic
villain.text: Play Turbo-Tastic without performing a Play a Card action. If any of your three available actions are covered, you may still take those actions.

villain.name: Have Some Candy
villain.text: Reveal the top five cards of your deck. Put up to two cards into your hand. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Out of Order
villain.text: If another player gains 2 or more Power during their turn, you may play Out of Order. Choose any card in your discard pile and put it into your hand.

villain.name: The Most Powerful Virus in the Arcade
villain.text: If another player moves an Ally or Item during their turn, you may play The Most Powerful Virus in the Arcade. Move forward two action spaces.

villain.name: Can't Be Allowed to Race
villain.text: Move any number of Allies to a Hero's location. Perform a Vanquish action, but do not discard the Allies used to defeat the Hero. Then, you may move the Racer token back three action spaces.

villain.name: Duncan and Wynnchel
villain.text: When Duncan and Wynnchel is played or moved, you may perform a Vanquish action.

villain.name: Pay to Race
villain.text: Before you perform actions on your turn, you may play Pay to Race without performing a Play a Card action. Pay up to 6 Power and move King Candy forward that number of action spaces.

villain.name: Ralph's Hero Medal
villain.text: When Ralph's Hero Medal is played, find Wreck-It Ralph and play him to this location. Attack Ralph's Hero Medal to him. When Wreck-It Ralph is defeated, find Vanellope von Schweetz and play her to this location.

villain.name: Sour Bill
villain.text: When Sour Bill is played or moved, you may reveal cards from the top of your deck until you find an Ally. Put the Ally in your hand and place the remaining cards back on top of your deck in any order.

villain.name: Taffyta Muttonfudge
villain.text: When Taffyta Muttonfudge is played or moved, move the Racer token back two Action spaces, or you may perform a Play a Card action.

fate.name: I Finally Have a Real Car!
fate.text: Reveal the top card of King Candy's deck. You may move the Racer token forward the number of action spaces equal to that card's Cost, plus one. Put the card on the bottom of his deck.

fate.name: Just Glazed Me
fate.text: King Candy must reveal his hand and discard two cards.

fate.name: Princess Vanellope
fate.text: Move King Candy back, up to four action spaces.

fate.name: Unfinished Level
fate.text: Look at the top four cards of King Candy's deck. Put two cards on the top and two on the bottom of his deck in any order.

fate.name: Fix-It Felix Jr.
fate.text:
When Fix-It Felix Jr. is played, you may move Vanellope von Schweetz to any location.
At the start of King Candy's turn, he can only move forward two or three action spaces.

fate.name: Sergeant Tamora Jean Calhoun
fate.text:
When Sergeant Tamora Jean Calhoun is played, you may move Vanellope von Schweetz to any location.
King Candy must pay 1 Power to perform a Play a Card action.

fate.name: The Beacon
fate.text: Choose a location and move all adjacent Candy Cy-Bugs in play to that location. You may remove one Candy Cy-Bug from that location.

fate.name: Vanellope von Schweetz
fate.text: Before King Candy moves, if Vanellope von Schweetz has a Glitch attached, reveal the top card of King Candy's deck and move the Racer token forward that card's Cost plus two action spaces. Put the card on the bottom of the deck.

fate.name: Vanellope's Medal
fate.text: You may choose and play a Hero from King Candy's discard pile. That Hero gains +1 Strength.

fate.name: What's With All the Magic Sparkles?
fate.text: You may discard a Glitch. If you discard a Glitch and a Glitch is still attached to Vanellope von Schweetz, move the Racer token three action spaces forward.

fate.name: Wreck-It Ralph
fate.text:
When Wreck-It Ralph is played, you may move Vanellope von Schweetz to any location.
King Candy must pay 1 Power to perform a Move an Item or Ally| action.

villain.name: Monkeys
villain.text: Activate: Pay 1 Power for each Fire token at this location. Remove all Fire tokens from this location and discard this Monkeys.

villain.name: Everyone Runs From Shere Khan
villain.text: When Everyone Runs From Shere Khan is played, perform an Activate or Vanquish action.

villain.name: Young and Helpless
villain.text: Move a Hero to a location with an Ally or gain 1 Power for each Ally in Shere Khan's Realm.

villain.name: Bravo! Bravo!
villain.text: Play Bravo! Bravo! without performing a Play a Card action. Perform one covered action at Shere Khan's location.

villain.name: Hey Cuz
villain.text: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an Ally. You may play that Ally for free. Discard the rest.

villain.name: How Interesting... How Delightful
villain.text: If an opponent performs a Play a Card action, play How Interesting... How Delightful. You may do any or all of these: collect 1 Power, draw one card, and move one Fire token to a new action.

villain.name: It's Me, Shere Khan
villain.text: Remove a Fire token from Shere Khan's location.

villain.name: Sure to Pick Up His Trail
villain.text: Defeat a Hero if Mowgli is in your Realm. If not, find and play Mowgli.

villain.name: Trust in Me
villain.text: If an opponent takes three or more actions on their turn, play Trust in Me. Choose up to three cards from your discard pile and shuffle them into yoru deck.

villain.name: You Will Inform Me First
villain.text: Discard the top three cards of your Fate deck. You may shuffle one card from your Fate discard pile into the Fate deck.

villain.name: Kaa
villain.text:
Kaa gets +2 Strength for each attached Item. When Kaa would be discarded, you may discard an Item attached to him instead.
Activate: Choose an Item from your discard pile, pay its cost, and play it.

villain.name: Kaa's Coils
villain.text: When Kaa's Coils is played, attach it to Kaa. When Kaa is moved, you may move a Hero from Kaa's previous location to his new location.

villain.name: Kaa's Eyes
villain.text: When Kaa's Eyes is played, attach it to Kaa. If Shere Khan is at this location, you may perform one action covered by a Hero but not by a Fire token.

villain.name: King Louie
villain.text: Activate: Move a Monkeys to any location in Shere Khan's Realm.

fate.name: Man's Red Fire
fate.text: Place a Fire token or move a Fire token to a new location.

fate.name: He's My Friend
fate.text: Choose a location in Shere Khan's Realm. All Heroes at that location get +1 Strength.

fate.name: Wolf Pack
fate.text: When Wolf Pack is played, discard a Monkeys or an Item from their location.

fate.name: Bagheera
fate.text: When Bagheera is played, you may move all Heroes and Allies from his location to any other locations.

fate.name: Baloo
fate.text: When another Hero would be defeated, place a Power token on Baloo instead. When Baloo has three Power tokens on him, discard the Power tokens and Baloo.

fate.name: Mowgli
fate.text: When Mowgli is played or moved, add a Fire token to his new location.

fate.name: The Jungle Patrol
fate.text: When The Jungle Patrol is played, reveal the top card of Shere Khan's Fate deck. If it is an Effect, play it. Otherwise, return it to the top of the deck.

fate.name: Tiger by the Tail
fate.text: You may move a Hero to any location. You may move Shere Khan to a location with a Hero.

fate.name: Vultures
fate.text: You may play Vultures to a location with another Hero. When played, move Vultures and that Hero to another location.

villain.name: The Crew of the Flying Dutchman
villain.text: Gain +1 Strength for every other location with an Ally in it.

villain.name: Do You Fear Death?
villain.text: Reveal Fate cards until you find a Hero. Discard the rest. Play that Hero to any location and place a facedown Treasure token on that Hero.

villain.name: The Chase
villain.text: Move any Hero to a location with an Ally.

villain.name: Friends Becoming Enemies
villain.text: Trade Treasure tokens between two Heroes or move a Treasure token from one Hero to another.

villain.name: I'll Take That As a "No"
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with 3 or less Strength, you may play I'll Take That As a "No." Choose two cards from your discard pile and put them into your hand.

villain.name: The Black Spot
villain.text: Reveal a facedown Treasure token on a Hero.

villain.name: They're Here
villain.text: During their turn, if another player discards two or more cards, you may play They're Here. Place a facedown Treasure token on a Hero without one.

villain.name: Wake the Kraken!
villain.text: Discard an Ally from play. Find The Kraken and play it to Davy Jones' location for free.

villain.name: Wyvern Speaks
villain.text: During their turn, if another player plays an Ally, you may play Wyvern Speaks. Draw three cards, then discard two cards from your hand.

villain.name: Bootstrap Bill
villain.text: When Bootstrap Bill is played or moved to a new location, you may reveal a Treasure token on a Hero at that new location.

villain.name: Clanker
villain.text: This location gains: Vanquish action.

villain.name: First Mate Maccus
villain.text: When First Mate Maccus is used to defeat a Hero, you may discard another Ally from your Realm instead of him.

villain.name: Hadras
villain.text: When Hadras is discarded from play, reveal a facedown Treasure token on a Hero.

villain.name: The Flying Dutchman
villain.text: If Davy Jones is at this location, he may take a non-Fate action at another location with The Crew of the Flying Dutchman.

villain.name: The Kraken
villain.text: The Kraken is not discarded when it defeats a Hero with a revealed Treasure token.

fate.name: Calypso's Love
fate.text: Reduce Davy Jones' Power to 2.

fate.name: Curse You, Jack Sparrow
fate.text: Remove a Treasure token from a Hero. Shuffle it into the supply. Place a Treasure token face down on a Hero that does not have one.

fate.name: Where Does It Point?
fate.text: You may move one Hero with a Treasure token to any location. You may move one Hero without a Treasure token to any location.

fate.name: Elizabeth Swann
fate.text: Gain +1 Strength when another Hero is played.

fate.name: Jack Sparrow
fate.text: If Davy Jones is at Jack Sparrow's location, Davy Jones cannot perform a Vanquish action.

fate.name: James Norrington
fate.text: When Davy Jones collects a Treasure token, James Norrington gets 1 Strength. When James Norrington is defeated, Davy Jones gets 2 Power.

fate.name: The Black Pearl
fate.text: Attach The Black Pearl to a Hero. When the Hero is defeated, if there is another Hero at this location, attach The Black Pearl to that Hero.

fate.name: The Crew of the Black Pearl
fate.text: Gain +1 Strength for each other Hero in play.

fate.name: Will Turner
fate.text: When Will Turner is played or moved, discard an Ally with a Strength of 2 or less from his new location.

villain.name: Eight-Eyed Bats
villain.text: Each time an Ally is played, you may move Eight-Eyed Bats to their location

villain.name: Not Exactly Maui Time
villain.text: Reveal the top card of the Maui deck. You may play it or discard it.

villain.name: Crustacean With the Power of Creation
villain.text: You may shuffle your Fate discard pile into your deck. Reveal the top four cards. Play each Item revealed to a different location. Discard remaining cards.

villain.name: Bait
villain.text: Draw a card for each Hero in your Realm.

villain.name: Fish Are Dumb
villain.text: During their turn, if an opponent takes two or fewer actions, play Fish Are Dumb. Gain 3 Power.

villain.name: I'll Tell You in Song
villain.text: Shuffle three discarded Villain cards into your deck. Draw two cards.

villain.name: Nice and Shiny
villain.text: Gain 2 Power. Shuffle Maui's discard pile back into his deck.

villain.name: Not So Tough
villain.text: During their turn, if another player plays an Ally with 3 or less Strength, you may play Not So Tough. On your next turn, all cards played cost 1 less Power.

villain.name: Trapped
villain.text: You may take one non-Fate action covered by any Hero.

villain.name: You Look Like Seafood
villain.text: Pay Power equal to the Strength of a Hero. Defeat that Hero.

villain.name: Fish Monster
villain.text: Fish Monster can be used in Vanquish actions against Heroes in adjacent location.

villain.name: Maui's Hook
villain.text: While Maui's Hook is unattached, each time a Fate action targets Tamatoa, gain 2 Power. When Maui is defeated while Maui's Hook is attached, Maui's Hook returns to Tamatoa at the same location.

villain.name: Powerless
villain.text: Give a Heroes up to three -1 Strength tokens.

villain.name: Sloth Monster
villain.text: Heroes at Sloth Monster's location get -1 Strength.

villain.name: Tree Monster
villain.text: When Tree Monster is used to defeat a Hero, you may move any card in play to a new location.

fate.name: Maui Time
fate.text: Find Maui and play him. Find Maui's Hook and attach it to Maui.

fate.name: Something Shiny
fate.text: Something Shiny covers actions like Heroes and is not attached to Heroes. Heroes at this location cannot be defeated. When Tamatoa ends his turn at this location, discard this Item.

fate.name: Escape
fate.text: Move a Hero or unattached Item to an adjacent location.

fate.name: Still Upside Down
fate.text: Tamatoa loses half his Power (round up).

fate.name: Heart of Te Fiti
fate.text: Play Heart of Te Fiti, unattached, to any location. Find Moana and attach Heart of Te Fiti to her at that location. When Moana is defeated, move Heart of Te Fiti to Tamatoa's side of the Realm at this location.

fate.name: Maui
fate.text: Before Tamatoa moves, he must reveal and play the top card of his Maui deck.

fate.name: Mini Maui
fate.text: Look at the top three cards of the Maui deck and return them in any order.

fate.name: Moana
fate.text: When Moana is played, if the Heart of Te Fiti is at her location, attach it to her.

cards.name: Beetle Maui
cards.text: Shuffle together all Allies in Tamatoa's Realm. Randomly distribute them between all locations as evenly as possible.

cards.name: Fish Maui
cards.text: Tamatoa reveals his hand. Gain 1 Power for each Condition in your hand, then discard your Conditions.

cards.name: Heihei Maui
cards.text: When revealed, immediately discard Heihei Maui, then reveal and play the next two Maui cards.

cards.name: Lizard Maui
cards.text: Tamatoa discards an Ally from his Realm. Gain Power equal to that Ally's Strength.

cards.name: Pig Maui
cards.text: Tamatoa immediately loses 3 Power and draws four cards.

cards.name: Reindeer Maui
cards.text: Discard the top two cards from your Fate and Villain decks.

cards.name: Sea Star Maui
cards.text: On your next turn, Tamatoa does not have to move to a new location.

cards.name: Shark Head Maui
cards.text: All Allies get +2 Strength. All Heroes get +1 Strength.

cards.name: Shark Maui
cards.text: Play the top card of your Fate deck on yourself. Discard the top two Villain cards from your deck.

cards.name: Shark Tail Maui
cards.text: All Allies get +1 Strength. All Heroes get +1 Strength.

villain.name: Security Guards
villain.text: When Security Guards is played, you may move a Hero to this location.

villain.name: I Did All My Own Stunts
villain.text: Perform a Move Ally/Item action or a Move a Hero action.

villain.name: I Have a Great Great Grandson
villain.text: Find Miguel Rivera and play him to Ernesto de la Cruz's location.

villain.name: Poco Loco
villain.text: Reveal Fate cards from the top of your Fate deck until you reveal a Hero. Play that Hero and discard the rest. Flip a photo card.

villain.name: Extending His Stay
villain.text: Choose one card from the Villain discard pile and put it into your hand. Shuffle the Villain discard pile back into your deck.

villain.name: Forgetting Me
villain.text: Choose one photo card. Flip all adjacent cards.

villain.name: From My Amazing Fans
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has an Ally at their current location you may play From My Amazing Fans. Draw two Villain cards.

villain.name: I Would Move Heaven and Earth
villain.text: Perform a Vanquish action, then flip one photo card.

villain.name: Most Beloved Musician
villain.text: During their turn, if another player uses a Play a Card action, you may play Most Beloved Musician. Gain Power equal to the cost of that card.

villain.name: Seize Your Moment
villain.text: Discard an Ally from Ernesto de la Cruz's location. You may discard any Heroes at that location. Flip one photo card for each Hero discarded.

villain.name: Whatever It Takes
villain.text: Flip a photo card, then discard a card from your hand.

villain.name: Bouncer
villain.text: When Bouncer is played, look at the top three cards in your Fate deck. Discard any Heroes and place the others on the top of your deck in any order.

villain.name: Ernesto's Guitar
villain.text: This location gains: Gain 2 Power action.

fate.name: ...Until 1942
fate.text: Flip up to two adjacent photo cards face up.

fate.name: Broadcasting
fate.text: Ernesto de la Cruz loses Power equal to the number of Heroes in play.

fate.name: Escape Plan
fate.text: You may move a Hero to a new location or move an Ally out of this location.

fate.name: Dante
fate.text: When Dante is played, find Miguel Rivera and play him to Dante's location.

fate.name: Family Blessing
fate.text: When Family Blessing is played, attach it to a Hero. Until that Hero is defeated, Ernesto cannot flip photo cards face down.

fate.name: Héctor Rivera
fate.text: Ernesto de la Cruz cannot win while this card is in play. Héctor Rivera gains +1 Strength for each face-up photo card.

fate.name: Mamá Imelda
fate.text: When Mamá Imelda is played, flip up to two corner photo cards face up.

fate.name: Miguel Rivera
fate.text: When Miguel Rivera is played, flip a photo card. If Miguel is moved to a new location and it has an Ally, flip a photo card face down. If it has a Hero, flip a photo card face up.

fate.name: Pepita
fate.text: When Pepita is played, find Mamá Imelda and play her to Pepita's location.

fate.name: Remember Me
fate.text: Find Héctor Rivera and play him to any location. Then for each Hero in play, flip one photo card face up.

fate.name: Rivera Ancestors
fate.text: If Rivera Ancestors is revealed during a Fate action and the other revealed card is a Hero, you may play both cards revealed during that action.

fate.name: Rivera Family
fate.text: If Rivera Family is revealed during a Fate action and the other revealed card is a Hero, you may play both cards revealed during that action.

villain.name: Wolves
villain.text: Gain +1 Strength for each Frozen Ring token at this location.

villain.name: I Love Crazy
villain.text: If Anna is in play, draw two cards or gain a Vanquish action. If Anna is not in play, gain 3 Power or place 2 Frozen Ring tokens on any actions.

villain.name: Monster!
villain.text: If Elsa is in play, fill any one location with Frozen Ring tokens. If she is not in play, collect 3 Frozen Ring tokens and place them on any actions.

villain.name: Prince Hans In Charge
villain.text: Find Elsa or Anna and place them at Prince Hans' location.

villain.name: Sorcery!
villain.text: Collect 4 Frozen Ring tokens. Place them on any actions

villain.name: A Real Howler in July
villain.text: Gain Power equal to the number of Frozen Ring tokens at Prince Hans' location.

villain.name: Don't Feel
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has an Ally at their location, you may play Don't Feel. You may play 2 Frozen Ring tokens on any actions.

villain.name: Finish Each Other's Sandwiches
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has gained Power, you may play Finish Each Other's Sandwiches. Discard cards from your hand equal to the Power gained. Draw back up to 4 cards.

villain.name: So Desperate For Love
villain.text: If Anna is in play, remove any other Hero except Elsa. If she is not in play, Prince Hans may perform one action not covered by a Hero from each adjacent location this turn.

villain.name: You Froze Her Heart
villain.text: If Elsa is in play, reduce her Strength by 1. If she is not in play, count the Heroes in play and add that many Frozen Ring tokens on any actions.

villain.name: Duke of Weselton
villain.text: If Prince Hans is at Duke of Weselton's location, you may choose an Effect from your deck and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

villain.name: Erik
villain.text: After you play an Effect, you may move an Ally to an adjacent location.

villain.name: Francis
villain.text: After you play an Effect, you may draw a card, then you may discard a card from your hand.

fate.name: Do You Want to Build a Snowman?
fate.text: Choose and play a Hero from Prince Hans' Fate discard pile. If Anna or Elsa are in Prince Hans' Realm, move one of them to any location.

fate.name: Let It Go
fate.text: Choose a Hero in Prince Hans' Realm to get +2 Strength.

fate.name: The Love Experts
fate.text: All other Heroes at The Love Experts' location get +1 Strength.

fate.name: True Love
fate.text: Remove a Frozen Ring token from each location.

fate.name: Anna
fate.text: Anna cannot be defeated while there are other Heroes at her location. When Anna is defeated at a fully frozen location, remove her from the game.

fate.name: Elsa
fate.text: At Elsa's location. Prince Hans cannot perform actions that have a Frozen Ring token on them. When Elsa is defeated at a fully frozen location, remove her from the game.

fate.name: Kristoff
fate.text: When Kristoff is played, you may move an Ally to any location.

fate.name: Marshmallow
fate.text: Marshmallow gains +1 Strength for each Frozen Ring token at its location.

fate.name: Olaf
fate.text: When Prince Hans moves to Olaf's location, remove a Frozen Ring token from that location. Prince Hans then moves Olaf to a new location.

fate.name: Sven
fate.text: When Sven is played, you may move another Hero to any location.

fate.name: The Real Frozen Heart
fate.text: Prince Hans loses all of his Power. Remove a Frozen Ring token from Prince Hans' location.

villain.name: Dance, Dance, Dance
villain.text:
Choose one of the following Abilities for each Witch currently in your Realm. Each Ability can only be used once.
• Move a Witch to any new location.
• Move a Hero to any new location.
• A Witch gains 1 Strength.

villain.name: Just Enough Left
villain.text: Gain Vanquish action or Activate action.

villain.name: Pay the Toll
villain.text: Gain Move a Hero action. Draw 2 cards.

villain.name: Share the Life Force
villain.text: Perform a Vanquish action at a Witch's location. If there is more than one Witch at this location, do not discard any Witches.

villain.name: We're Home
villain.text: Find a Witch and play it to the Sanderson Sisters' Cottage for free or move all Witches in play to the Sanderson Sisters' Cottage.

villain.name: You Can't Save Your Friends
villain.text: If there are Witches in two adjacent locations in your Realm, remove an Item card in play. If there are Witches in three adjacent locations, you may remove a second Item card.

villain.name: Just a Bunch of Hocus Pocus
villain.text: When a player takes a Vanquish action on their turn, you may play Just a Bunch of Hocus Pocus. Gain Power equal to the number of Tokens in your Witches' Cauldron.

villain.name: Master!
villain.text: Move a Witch or a Hero to Salem Town. You may pay 1 Power for each additional Witch or Hero you wish to move to Salem Town.

villain.name: We're Young... Well, Younger
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has taken 3 or more actions, you may play We're Young... Well, Younger. Move an Ally or Witch to a new location.

villain.name: Ice
villain.text: This location gains: Activate action.

villain.name: Jay
villain.text: When at Jay's location, you may move a Witch or Ally to any location.

villain.name: Make Thyself Known
villain.text: Find any card in your deck or discard pile and put it in your hand.

villain.name: Mary Sanderson
villain.text:
Mary Sanderson gains +1 Strength for every other Witch in play.
Activate: Find and play a Hero to Mary Sanderson's location.

villain.name: Sarah Sanderson
villain.text:
Sarah Sanderson gains +1 Strength for every other Witch in play.
Activate: Move all Heroes in play to Sarah Sanderson's location.

villain.name: Winifred Sanderson
villain.text:
Winifred Sanderson gains +1 Strength for every other Witch in play.
Activate: The cost to play an Effect is reduced by 1 Power.

fate.name: Burning Rain of Death
fate.text: This player discards two random cards from the Sanderson Sisters' hand. Move a Witch, Ally, or Hero to a new location.

fate.name: Daylight Savings
