fate.text: Play this card on top of the current Recipe page. That page cannot be completed. Discard Daylight Savings when a Witch is moved to Salem Cemetery.

fate.name: Hallowed Ground
fate.text: Play Hallowed Ground to a location. Hallowed Ground blocks actions like a Hero. Cards at this location cannot be Vanquished or Activated.

fate.name: Salt
fate.text: Attach Salt to a Hero. This Hero cannot be moved, or affected by any Vanquish action.

fate.name: Allison Watts
fate.text: When played, find Salt and attach it to a Hero.

fate.name: Binx
fate.text: When you move to Binx's location, draw Fate cards until you reveal an Effect card. Play that card. Items and tokens cannot be attached to Binx. Binx cannot be defeated.

fate.name: Dani Dennison
fate.text: While in play, Dani Dennison must be defeated before any other Hero.

fate.name: Fire, It's Hot!
fate.text: Remove a Witch and put it in the Villain deck. Shuffle the deck.

fate.name: Max Dennison
fate.text: When played, if the Life Potion is attached to another Hero, move it to Max Dennison. While in play, when the Life Potion is completed, it must be attached to Max Dennison.

fate.name: Sunrise
fate.text: All Witches gain -1 Strength.

fate.name: We Have a Child
fate.text: Discard an Ally. Shuffle the Sanderson Sisters' discard pile back into their deck.

villain.name: Boarding Party
villain.text: When performing a Vanquish action, Boarding Party may be used to defeat a Hero at their location or at an adjacent unlocked location.

villain.name: Give Them a Scare
villain.text: Look at the top two cards of your Fate deck. Either discard both cards or return them to the top in any order.

villain.name: Swashbuckler
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Worthy Opponent
villain.text: Gain 2 Power. Reveal cards from the top of your Fate deck until you reveal a Hero. Play that Hero and discard the rest.

villain.name: Aye, Aye, Sir!
villain.text: Move an Ally to an adjacent unlocked location. That Ally gets +2 Strength until the end of your turn.

villain.name: Cannon
villain.text: This location gains: Vanquish action.

villain.name: Cunning
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has an Ally with a Strength of 3 or more in their realm, you may play Cunning. Play an Ally from your hand for free.

villain.name: Cutlass
villain.text: When Cutlass is played, attach it to an Ally. That Ally gets +2 Strength.

villain.name: Hook's Case
villain.text: This location gains: Gain 1 Power action.

villain.name: Obsession
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 3 or more, you may play Obsession. Reveal cards from the top of your Fate deck until you reveal a Hero. Either play or discard the Hero. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Pirate Brute
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Ingenious Device
villain.text: This location gains: Move a Hero action.

villain.name: Mr. Starkey
villain.text: When Mr. Starkey is played, you may move a Hero from his location to an adjacent unlocked location.

villain.name: Neverland Map
villain.text:
When Neverland Map is played, find Peter Pan and play him.
When you defeat a Hero, you may discard Neverland Map.

villain.name: Smee
villain.text: Smee gets +2 Strength if he is at the Jolly Roger.

fate.name: Pixie Dust
fate.text: When Pixie Dust is played, attach it to a Hero. That Hero gets +2 Strength.

fate.name: Lost Boys
fate.text: When performing a Vanquish action to defeat Lost Boys, at least two Allies must be used.

fate.name: Splitting Headache
fate.text: Discard an Item from Captain Hook's Realm.

fate.name: Taunt
fate.text: When Taunt is played, attach it to a Hero. Captain Hook must defeat Heroes with Taunt before defeating other Heroes.

fate.name: John
fate.text: John gets +1 Strength if he has any Items attached to him.

fate.name: Michael
fate.text: Michael gets +1 Strength for each location in Captain Hook's Realm that has a Hero, including Michael's location.

fate.name: Peter Pan
fate.text: Peter Pan can only be played to Lost Boys' Hideout. While Neverland Map is in Captain Hook's Realm, Peter Pan cannot be moved.

fate.name: Tick Tock
fate.text: If Captain Hook moves to Tick Tock's location, Captain Hook must immediately discard his hand.

fate.name: Tinker Bell
fate.text: When Tinker Bell is played, discard one Ally from her location

fate.name: Wendy
fate.text: All other Heroes in Captain Hook's Realm get +1 Strength.

villain.name: Cackling Goon
villain.text: Cackling Goon gets +1 Strength for each Hero at his location.

villain.name: Dragon Form
villain.text: Defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less. If a Fate action targets you before your next turn, gain 3 Power.

villain.name: Forest of Thorns
villain.text:
Forest of Thornes can only be played to a location with an Ally.
Heroes must have a Strength of 4 or more to be played to this location.
Discard this Curse when a Hero is played to this location.

villain.name: Green Fire
villain.text:
Green Fire can only be played to a location with an Ally
Heroes cannot be played to this location.
Discard this Curse if Maleficent moves to this location.

villain.name: Savage Goon
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Sinister Goon
villain.text: Sinister Goon gets +1 Strength if there are any Curses at his location.

villain.name: Vanish
villain.text: At the start of your next turn, Maleficent does not have to move to a new location.

villain.name: Dreamless Sleep
villain.text:
Dreamless Sleep can only be played to a location with an Ally.
Heroes at this location get -2 Strength.
Discard this Curse when an Ally is played to this location.

villain.name: Malice
villain.text: During thier turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 3 or more, you may play Malice. Defeat a Hero with a Strength of 3 or less.

villain.name: Tyranny
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has three or more Allies in their Realm, you may play Tyranny. Draw three cards into your hand, then discard any three cards.

villain.name: Raven
villain.text: Before Maleficent moves, you may move Raven to any location and perform one available non-Fate action at his new location. Curses cannot be played to Raven's location.

villain.name: Spinning Wheel
villain.text: If a Hero is defeated at this location, gain Power equal to the Hero's Strength minus 1.

villain.name: Staff
villain.text: If Maleficent is at this location, the Cost to play an Effect or Curse is reduced by 1 Power.

fate.name: Guards
fate.text: When performing a Vanquish action to defeat Guards, at least two Allies must be used.

fate.name: Sword of Truth
fate.text: When Sword of Truth is played, attach it to a Hero with no other attached Items. The Cost to play a Curse to this location is increased by 2 Power.

fate.name: Once Upon a Dream
fate.text: Discard a Curse from a location in Maleficent's Realm that has a Hero.

fate.name: Aurora
fate.text: When Aurora is played, reveal the top card of Maleficent's Fate deck. If it is a Hero, play it. Otherwise, return it to the top of the deck.

fate.name: Fauna
fate.text: When Fauna is played, you may discard Dreamless Sleep from her location.

fate.name: Flora
fate.text:
When Flora is played, Maleficent must reveal her hand.
Until Flora is defeated, Maleficent must play with her hand revealed.

fate.name: King Hubert
fate.text: When King Hubert is played, you may move one Ally from each adjacent location to his location.

fate.name: King Stefan
fate.text: When King Stefan is played, you may move Maleficent to any location.

fate.name: Merryweather
fate.text: Curses cannot be played or moved to Merryweather's location.

fate.name: Prince Phillip
fate.text: When Prince Phillip is played, you may discard all Allies from his location.

villain.name: Beautiful, Lovely Taxes
villain.text: Gain 1 Power for each Hero in your Realm.

villain.name: Imprison
villain.text: Move any Hero except Robin Hood or Little John to The Jail.

villain.name: Rhino Guards
villain.text: No additional Ability.

villain.name: Warrant
villain.text: Gain 2 Power each time a Hero is played to this location.

villain.name: Wolf Archers
villain.text: When performing a Vanquish action, Wolf Archers may be used to defeat a Hero at their location or at an adjacent location.

villain.name: Bow and Arrows
villain.text: When Bow and Arrows is played, attach it to an Ally. That Ally gets +1 Strength. When that Ally would be discarded, discard this Item instead.

villain.name: Cowardice
villain.text: During thier turn, if another player defeats a Hero, you may play Cowardice. Reveal the top four cards of you Fate deck. You may play a Hero. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Greed
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has 6 or more Power, you may play Greed. Gain 3 Power.

villain.name: Set a Trap
villain.text: You may move an Ally to any location. Reveal the top four cards of your Fate deck. You may play a Hero. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Golden Arrow
villain.text: When Golden Arrow is played, attach it to an Ally. When that Ally is used to defeat a Hero, gain 2 Power.

villain.name: Intimidation
villain.text: Perform a Vanquish action, but do not discard the Allies used to defeat the Hero.

villain.name: King Richard's Crown
villain.text: If Prince John is at this location, all card Costs are reduced by 1 Power.

villain.name: Nutsy
villain.text: All other Allies at Nutsy's location get +1 Strength.

villain.name: Sheriff of Nottingham
villain.text: Before Prince John moves, you may move Sheriff of Nottingham to any location and gain 1 Power if there are any Heroes at his new location.

villain.name: Sir Hiss
villain.text: If Prince John is at Sir Hiss's location, you may perform one action that is covered by a Hero at that location.

villain.name: Trigger
villain.text: All other Allies at Trigger's location get -1 Strength.

fate.name: Clever Disguise
fate.text: When Clever Disguise is played, attach it to a Hero. That Hero cannot be defeated. At any time, Prince John may pay 2 Power to discard Clever Disguise.

fate.name: Steal from the Rich
fate.text: Take 4 Power from Prince John and put it on any one Hero. You cannot place Power on a Hero at The Jail. When that Hero is defeated, the Power is returned to Prince John.

fate.name: Alan-a-Dale
fate.text: All other Heroes in Prince John's Realm get +1 Strength.

fate.name: Friar Tuck
fate.text: When Friar Tuck is played, you may discard all Warrants from his location. Prince John does not gain any Power from them.

fate.name: King Richard
fate.text: Prince John cannot play Effects.

fate.name: Lady Kluck
fate.text: Lady Kluck cannot be played or moved to The Jail.

fate.name: Little John
fate.text: The amount of Power that Prince John gains from each card or action is reduced by 1 Power.

fate.name: Maid Marian
fate.text: When Maid Marian is defeated, find Robin Hood and play him.

fate.name: Robin Hood
fate.text:
When Robin Hood is revealed or found, you MUST PLAY HIM IMMEDIATELY to Sherwood Forest. Any other Fate cards revealed during this action are discarded.
When Robin Hood is defeated, move him to The Jail.

fate.name: Skippy
fate.text: Wolf Archers cannot be used to defeat Skippy.

fate.name: Toby
fate.text: When Toby is defeated, shuffle him back into Prince John's Fate deck.

villain.name: Binding Contract
villain.text:
Binding Contract can only be played to [location]. This location gains: Vanquish action.
When this Vanquish action is performed, place Binding Contract in the discard pile.
villain.versions: One version per location: Eric's Ship ×2, The Shore ×2, Ursula's Lair ×1, The Palace ×1. [location] in the text is that location.

villain.name: Change Form
villain.text: Look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. Discard one, put one on the bottom of your Fate deck, and put one back on top of your Fate deck.

villain.name: Grow Giant
villain.text: Perform one available action at a location adjacent to Ursula.

villain.name: Opportunist
villain.text: Choose an Item or Effect from your discard pile and put it into your hand.

villain.name: Whirlpool
villain.text: Draw five cards to your hand, then discard four cards.

villain.name: Arrogance
villain.text: During their turn, if another player defeats a Hero with a Strength of 3 or more, you may play Arrogance. You may play an Ally or Item from your hand for free.

villain.name: Divination
villain.text: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a Binding Contract. Put that Binding Contract into your hand. Discard the rest.

villain.name: Trickery
villain.text: During their turn, if another player has 6 or more Power, you may play Trickery. Reveal and play the top card of that player's Fate deck.

villain.name: Cauldron
villain.text: If Ursula is at this location, you may find an Ally or Binding Contract in your deck or discard pile and put that card in your hand.

villain.name: Crown
villain.text: Crown can only be played to The Palace

villain.name: Flotsam
villain.text: Flotsam is not discarded when they are used to defeat a Hero.

villain.name: Jetsam
villain.text: Jetsam is not discarded when they are used to defeat a Hero

villain.name: Poor Unfortunate Souls
villain.text: Defeat a Hero. You may move one unattached Item toward Ursula's lair.

villain.name: Trident
villain.text: Trident can only be played to The Shore

fate.name: Return to Form
fate.text: Choose a Hero with a Strength of 4 or less from Ursula's Fate discard pile. Play that Hero to Ursula's location.

fate.name: Dinglehopper
fate.text: When Dinglehopper is played, attach it to a Hero. Each time Ursula moves to this location, she loses 1 Power.

fate.name: Snarfblat
fate.text: When Snarfblat is played, attach it to a Hero with a Strength of 4 or less. Ursula must defeat Heroes with Snarfblat attached before defeating other Heroes.

fate.name: Ariel
fate.text: Until Ariel is defeated, Ursula cannot perform the Move an Item or Ally action.

fate.name: Eric
fate.text: When Eric is played you may move an red|Ally to any location.

fate.name: Flounder
fate.text: When Flounder is played, you may shuffle Ursula's Fate discard pile into her Fate deck.

fate.name: Grimsby
fate.text: When Grimsby is played, you may place a Binding Contract in the discard pile.

fate.name: King Triton
fate.text: When King Triton is played, move Trident and Crown to his location.

fate.name: Max
fate.text: When Max is played, you may move a Hero to any location.

fate.name: Scuttle
fate.text: When Scuttle is played, you may choose an Item from Ursula's Fate discard pile and attach it to Scuttle.

fate.name: Sebastian
fate.text: Villain Items cannot be moved to Sebastian's location.
